title: Notify affected staff
text: Tell everyone near the machine before shutdown.

title: Shut down the machine
text: Use the normal stop sequence.

title: Isolate energy sources
text: Switch off electrical, air and hydraulic supply.

title: Apply lock and tag
text: Each worker fits a personal lock and a tag.

title: Release stored energy
text: Bleed pressure and block moving parts.

title: Verify zero energy
text: Try to start the machine. It must not move.

title: Perform the work
text: Only after steps 1 to 6 are done.

title: Remove locks and restore
text: Check the area, then remove locks and restart.

title: Park in the charging bay
text: Set the brake and lower the forks.

title: Wear acid-resistant gloves and face shield
text: Required for all battery work.

title: Check vent caps and electrolyte level
text: Look before every charge.

title: Connect charger only when off
text: Plug in with the charger switched off.

title: Charge to full without interruption
text: Full charge takes eight hours.

title: Disconnect and wipe terminals
text: Switch off first, then unplug.

title: Issue entry permit
text: Supervisor signs before entry.

title: Test the atmosphere
text: Check oxygen and gas levels.

title: Ventilate for 15 minutes
text: Run the fan before anyone enters.

title: Station an attendant outside
text: One person stays at the opening.

title: Confirm rescue plan and radio check
text: Done at the start of each entry.

title: Enter and monitor continuously
text: Keep gas readings on screen.
